vocabulary.definition: Obtaining input into a task or project by enlisting the services of a large number of people, typically via the internet.

vocabulary.definition: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.
vocabulary.example: Scientists are studying the human genome to understand genetic diseases better.

vocabulary.definition: Large molecules composed of one or more long chains of amino acids and performing a variety of functions in the body.
vocabulary.example: Athletes often consume protein shakes to help with muscle recovery.
